entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning, deep learning, neural networks and algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering and dimensional reduction
Supervised and unsupervised models using SciPy and ScikitLearn
Deploying machine learning algorithms and pipelines on Apache Spark
Deep learning models and neural networks with Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow
Large language models and generative AI architectures
Natural language processing, attention mechanisms and transformers
Computer vision, image and video processing, and object recognition
reading.format: Delivered online as a Professional Certificate made up of a 13 course series, available in 19 languages. Learning is assessed through hands-on labs, projects and practical evaluations, including a portfolio project.
reading.summary: The IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a Professional Certificate from IBM offered on Coursera as a series of 13 courses. It teaches machine learning, deep learning and generative AI, including how to build, train and deploy large language models. Learners work through hands-on labs and projects and finish with a career credential and portfolio work that shows practical AI engineering skills.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers and other technical specialists who want to become ready for work as an AI engineer. It is listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
